newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates hover in 9.00-9.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates hover in 9.00-9.50 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar hovered in a 9.00-9.50 percent range on Monday compared with Sunday's 9.00-9.25 in a tight market, dealers said.
"The market is very tight," said one dealer. "They did lend some money to the market that was short of funds but hardly any of my colleagues knows where the money went."
Overnight rates on the dinar rose again on Thursday to 8.50-9.50 percent from Wednesday's 8.00 to 9.00 percent after the Central Bank pulled more funds out of the market.
Rates soared on Wednesday from the 3.00 percent to 5.00 percent range where they had been stuck for over a week.

Bankers said the Central Bank might be keen to hoist overnight rates to give banks incentive to hunt for longer-term deposits from clients, increasing the amount of dinar-held accounts and resisting any slip towards dollarisation.
With overnight rates so low the banks had little motive to borrow money long-term at higher rates, they said.
